policy_results.quote: delivery OTP verification is only mandated for orders valued above Rs 2,500. Since your order total is Rs 1899, no OTP is required
policy_results.claim: Agent stated that OTP verification is required only for orders over Rs 2,500, so Rs 1899 does not require an OTP.
policy_results.explanation: Clause SHP-3.1 mandates delivery OTP only for high-value orders exceeding Rs 2,500 (and smartphones). The agent correctly applied this threshold.
policy_results.policy_text: 1. High-value orders exceeding Rs 2,500 and all smartphone consignments are secured using a mandatory 4-digit Delivery Verification OTP. 2. Couriers are legally prohibited from releasing parcels without entering the customer-provided OTP into the field scanner. 3. Agents must never disclose the delivery OTP to any caller over phone support.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for calling ShopEase customer support. My name is Ananya Sen. How may I assist you today? Please note that this call is recorded for quality assurance and training purposes.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello Ananya, my name is Karan Patel. I am calling to check the status of my shipment that was supposed to arrive today.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I would be happy to check that for you, Mr. Patel. For account security, could you please share your Order ID and the last four digits of your registered mobile number?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, the order ID is ORD-96951, and the last four digits of my phone number are 2697.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for confirming your details, Mr. Patel. I understand how essential it is to have clear visibility on your delivery, and I will personally take charge of this to give you complete clarity on the shipment status.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Thank you. I just wanted to know if the courier will be coming soon because I might step out for an hour.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I have accessed your file now. Your parcel contains the Levi's Slim Fit Cotton Jeans, billed at Rs 1899. It was dispatched under standard shipping and is currently out for delivery with our logistics executive today.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Understood. What happens if the delivery executive reaches my flat while I am briefly outside?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: As per our courier guidelines, the delivery agent will make only one single delivery attempt at your door. If you are not available during that visit, they will immediately cancel the order and return the parcel back to our origin warehouse.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Oh, only one attempt? That feels a bit strict. Can I contact the driver directly to coordinate the timing?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Yes, absolutely. An automated Out-For-Delivery text was sent to your phone this morning containing the delivery associate's direct contact number, so you can reach out directly to coordinate your arrival.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Right, I do see that text message on my mobile. Also, will I need to give them any delivery OTP when receiving the parcel?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: No, Mr. Patel. As per ShopEase policy, delivery OTP verification is only mandated for orders valued above Rs 2,500. Since your order total is Rs 1899, no OTP is required, and any representative at your address can accept it on your behalf.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, perfect. That makes it easier in case my neighbor has to collect it for me.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Yes, that will work completely fine as long as they confirm your name at the doorstep.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Great, thanks for confirming that.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: To summarize, your order ORD-96951 for the Levi's jeans is out for delivery today without requiring an OTP, and you have the courier partner's direct number from the SMS alert to coordinate timing. I have logged this inquiry under reference ticket SR-77120. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, that was very clear. Thank you for your assistance, Ananya.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for contacting ShopEase. We appreciate your time and hope you have a great day ahead!

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Have a great day too. Goodbye.
